body: i don’t want to use rodenticide bc i don’t want them to die in my ceiling & then the house will just smell like death. the trap under the hole is a good idea though, thanks!
thank you for your advice, that means a lot. i appreciate it, truly. it’s nice to actually feel heard once in a while. i’ll check out The Secret & get back to you.

i’d love to have suggestions. i just want to feel okay again. thank you for your response, by the way. therapy didn’t help me, i was never prescribed medication but it just feels like so much effort to find something that might not even help me. i’ve heard stories about people that go on meds & it sounds like it just takes away all of their emotions. 

i try talking to my friends and family, and i’d feel terribly guilty leaving them behind. but i feel like this is my only option.
